- **No Recoil** - Attempts to get rid of recoil on guns.
- **Chest Dumper** - Dumps all items into inventories.
- **Passthrough** - Allows you to interact through certain blocks.

- **.channel** - Channel chat messages into commands.
- **.slot** - Switches your equipped slot. Range 1 - 9

- **Vulcan Disabler** now correctly disables when you're not wearing an elytra
- Added `.rtc reconnect`

- `.delay` now supports multiple delays at once
- Added announce to **Murder Mystery ESP**
- Fixed crash in Auto Macro that occurs when receiving 2 messages in the same tick
- Increased default Packet Length Threshold in **Better Anti Crash**
- Added Block Role Description, Party Mode, Announce and Blacklisted strings to **Murder Mystery ESP**
- **Click Events** and **Image HUD** are now available in 1.21.5+
- Removed binary opcode

releases.notes:
# Happy Thanksgiving!

## New Modules
- **Click Events** - ClickEvent Utils
- **Murder Mystery ESP** - ESP for Hypixel Murder Mystery.
- **Silent Swap** - Silently swaps to an item and back.
- **Parkour Bot** - Automatically does parkour for you by teleporting.
- **Safe Elytra** - Attempts to prevent dying from kinetic energy.
## New Commands
- **.dupe** - Dupes the item in your hand & drops the results. (This is for dupe servers for mass duping, not an actual dupe)
- **.delay** - Sends the provided message after a specific delay.
- **.copyitem** - Copy someone's items.
## New HUD
- **Image** - Displays an image from the provided URL (Not available on 1.21.5 & above)
## Other Changes
- Added length filters to **BetterAntiCrash** for items, boss bars, entities, packets and chat messages
- Added outgoing § block to **BetterAntiCrash**
- You can now disable specific items on the ground in **BetterAntiCrash**
- Fixed **BetterAntiCrash** sometimes crashing the game on activate
- **Troll** is now more stable
- Enhanced **AutoMacro**
- Online Asteroide users are now suggested in `.rtc` when typing @
- Translation Crashes in **BetterAntiCrash** no longer display multiple [Translation Blocked] messages on items
- Fixed commands sometimes displaying twice in **ClickEvents**
- Added a limit of chat messages per X seconds/ticks/etc in **BetterAntiCrash**
- Fixed `.phase` teleporting you up when inside a vehicle
- Hud colors are now compatible with Asteroide HUD elements
- **MinehutAutoJoin** now supports categories
- Added packet canceller for lag reduce to **MinehutAutoJoin**
- The RTC now supports #RRGGBB hex color codes
- Added more chat colors to the RTC
- Added starscript support to the RTC
- AFK Players are now grayed out in `.rtc online`
- Made **BlockHitboxes** more customizable
- Fixed RTC connecting multiple times when you have a bad connection
- Added more delay customization to most modules
- Enhanced `.uuid`
- Enhanced **ChestStealer**
- Fixed SSL issues in the RTC
- Packet names are no longer obfuscated in **PacketLogger** and **BetterAntiCrash**
- Added more options to **RTCSettings**

*"why is there a binary opcode"*
~ volcan
   
**Discord & Support**: https://discord.gg/QFzE3UzdpQ/
**Bug Reports & Feature Requests**: [Create an Issue](https://github.com/asteroide-development/Asteroide/issues)
*If you like Asteroide, please give it a ⭐ on github!*

releases.notes:
# Thank you for 2000 users!

## New Modules
- **Better No Interact** - No interact, but better.
- **Better Anti Crash** - Fixes various exploits and crashes.
- **Auto Crash** - Automatically kicks/bans/crashes a player when they join the server.
- **Chat Bypass** - Bypasses most chat filters.
- **No Occlusion** - Removes ambient occlusion.
- **Packet Kick** - Kicks you for sending too many packets.
- **Auto Command** - Automatically runs a command when you are in a specific area.
- **Packet Pause** - Pauses packets until the module is disabled.
- **Typo** - Replace text in sent messages/commands.
## New Commands
- **.uuid** - Shows you a players uuid.
## Other Changes
- Fixed `.close`
- Added New mode to **Chest Stealer**, working with all containers
- Asteroide users are now highlighted in the player list
- Fixed Module Names to be compatible with other addons
- Fixed reconnecting in the RTC connecting multiple times
- Fixed **Inv Cleaner**
- You can now customize the command in **Auto Back**
- Added Item Filters to **Auto Hotbar** (still kind of buggy)
- **Auto Macro** is now more stable
- Fixed **Minehut Auto Join**
- Removed Always Bypass option from **Word Filter**, as it's a separate module now
- Completely rewrote **Auto Chatgame** to be more stable, optimized & faster
- Cleaned up some modules' code
- Improved **Tracker**
- Fixed RTC disconnecting for no reason at all
- Fixed WorldBorderMixin to be compatible with meteor
- Added some more quotes to **Troll**
- Added delay option to **Auto Back**
- Added Fillout, Unscramble, Trivia & Variable to **Auto Chatgame**
- You can now toggle RTC message visibility using `.rtc hide`
- You can now toggle online messages from the RTC using the **RTC Settings** Module
- Removed useless `.rtc kick`
- Fixed **Server Crash**
- You can now use & color codes in the RTC
- Asteroide now has a custom tag when `.toggle`ing modules by asteroide
- Added `.rtc discord`
   
  
**Discord & Support**: https://discord.gg/QFzE3UzdpQ/
**Bug Reports & Feature Requests**: [Create an Issue](https://github.com/asteroide-development/Asteroide/issues)
*If you like Asteroide, please give it a ⭐ on github!*
